prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic indoor gym portrait of an approved adult woman stretching after strength training.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with a focused serious expression and visible post-workout sheen, wearing a fitted pink sports crop top and matching pink sweatpants. She stretches one arm across her chest.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium portrait with the subject centered in a clean organized fitness center. Include weight machines, dumbbells, and hanging lights in the background with realistic depth.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm indoor gym lighting, natural sweat and skin texture, focused active-lifestyle mood, realistic equipment and fabric detail.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital photograph, vertical 4:5 framing, sharp subject, softly detailed gym background, natural perspective and accurate hands.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 indoor gym portrait of an approved adult woman with a focused serious expression and natural post-workout sheen. She wears a fitted pink sports crop top and matching pink sweatpants and stretches one arm across her chest after strength training. Center her in a clean organized fitness center with weight machines, dumbbells, and hanging lights behind her. Use warm indoor lighting, realistic skin and fabric texture, accurate anatomy, and a focused active-lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, malformed equipment
